steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: 12 o'clock—no, 4 o'clock!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: 7 o'clock now! It's coming—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Raise your shield!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Did it just... breathe fire?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Obviously.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Even the rocks are charred. Haven't seen anything like that since Blaze's arts.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And I'm sure she'd love to have a go at it.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Watch out! Here it comes!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Ngh!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's no good!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Its movements are too large. Whenever we try to counterattack, it just pushes us away or flies out of range.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We're stuck on the defensive. We have to try to close the distance.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Watch out, Yato—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Think about its movements... It whips its tail left and right while on the ground before charging forward to bite...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It also accelerates to charge, and flies up to breathe fire!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Tailspin, bite, charge, fire breath... here comes the tail, Corne!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Oof! Got it!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: At the very least, we have to be able to close in.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You want to try that? The timing might be hard though.

spans.text: ? The timing might be hard though.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I was thinking the same thing... over here!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's cumbersome... Phew—it needs time to find its footing after movement.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: We can take that opportunity to get in close.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Get me above its neck. I'll try to kill it in one blow.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Ready—dodge!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Here we go!
Noir Corne and I knew what to do. We've done this many times.
The moment I step onto the shield, I feel a great force from beneath, sending me into the sky.
My sword draws a sharp arc through the air and heads straight down, nothing between it and its target.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: My sword was deflected!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It's taking off!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ugh, that roar—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: My head's buzzing—I can't move—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (It's preparing to breathe fire! Dodge to the side!)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Argh!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You're hurt! Are you okay?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It just grazed my arm, I'm fine. I didn't expect it to dive like that all of a sudden.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato... you dropped your sword.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I... I can't keep a grip on it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What... happened to my arm?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Seems like something else drew its attention. It's looking away.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Let's get out of here while we can!

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Coming through! Here comes the cart!

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Push!

steps.name: Strange Yellow Creature
steps.text: Where to?

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Don't ask meow! Just push!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato, those strange Felines are coming over with what looks like a bunch of scrap wood...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey, what are you doing? Get away from Yato!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'm warning you! Don't even think about putting her on that thing!

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Were mew trimming the Rathalos's claws, horned 'Hunter'?

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Mew can't pawssibly win fur now! Hop on!

steps.name: Strange Yellow Creature
steps.text: Can't pawssibly!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Stay away! I'm warning you!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Don't touch me! Hey, not there... put me down!

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Get on!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No—

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Smithy? Is this really how we're supposed to push? Why is the cart so rickety?

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Mrow? So you've only ever seen other Felynes push their carts?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Where... where am I?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What's this? A cart... made of wood? Feels like it could fall apart any moment.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: My head hurts... something hit me...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato... Yato! Where is she?

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Hey, horned Hunter! Where are your herbs?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...Herbs? What herbs?

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Then what about antidotes?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What are you talking about...?

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Surely mew have Blue Mushrooms on mew? Good thing I have Antidote Herbs.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Mushrooms...? Why would I carry mushrooms with me?

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: That's not good. Are New World Hunters always so un-purr-pared?

steps.name: Strange Yellow Creature
steps.text: Un-purr-pared?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Who are you? Local Felines?

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: Fel-INE? No, FEEL-yne! F-E-L-Y-N-E!

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: I'm a top researcher from Bherna Village, furmer Royal Purr-leontology Scrivener, a blue-blooded Felyne Scholar! I'm here to study the New World!

steps.name: Strange Yellow Creature
steps.text: Mrow!

steps.name: Strange White Creature
steps.text: And this is Smithy from Purr-okke village! We met along the way.

steps.name: Strange Yellow Creature
steps.text: Artisan! Felyne Artisan!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: We're both Felynes!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Felyne!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So you're Felynes... but not Felines?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Never mew mind that! The girl's been purr-oisoned by the Rathalos. She needs an antidote, now!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: W-What happened to Yato? You said she's poisoned?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: She's unconscious fur now. I did some furst-aid, but the purr-oison's still there.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Rathalos poison's really dangerous. It can even kill a Rhenopurr-los this big!

spans.text: Rathalos poison's really dangerous. It can even kill a Rhenopurr-los

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I need to— Put me down!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I thought New World Hunters were the elite of the elite, but this one's not so smart.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: They don't even have antidotes! What to do? The lass is pretty badly purr-oisoned, and there are no suitable mushrooms in the forest...

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Village!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Right, the fastest way is to get some from a village! Remember the one that we saw from a distance?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The Hunters there can't pawssibly lack basic ingredients like these! I'm so smart!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Hey, dumb horned Hunter! We're going to go get Blue Mushrooms fur the antidote!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Find a camp to rest at and wait fur us!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Camp? Where? Hey!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: No time to waste! Let's go!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: That night, the sky was set on fire, and the great monster came down from the forest, trying to burn the village down with its flames!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: The village hunter stepped forward and told the others, 'I'm a hunter, so I'll protect the village!'

steps.name: Child Playing the Monster
steps.text: 'How dare you try to stop my flames of destruction, puny little hunter!'

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: 'You won't take another step forward, monster!'

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: The hunter raises his weapon and fights the monster threatening the village.

steps.name: Child Playing the Monster
steps.text: Giant fireball!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: Hnf! Haah!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: (Wrestles)

steps.name: Child Playing the Monster
steps.text: Argh!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: Ha!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: I win!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: I told you! The hunter always wins!

steps.name: Child Playing the Monster
steps.text: No! I didn't lose!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: Don't be a sore loser! I took you down!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: The hunter never loses, no matter how scary the monster is!

steps.name: Child Playing the Monster
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Child Playing the Monster
steps.text: Dad told me that there aren't any hunters anymore.

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: You're lying! Old Kashiwau living on the south side of the village is a great hunter!

steps.name: Child Playing the Monster
steps.text: Dad says old Kashiwau is just a stubborn old man.

steps.name: Child Playing the Monster
steps.text: There aren't any hunters left because the village doesn't need them anymore. That's why the monster won't lose!
The fallen red leaves on the ground tell of late autumn.
The houses in the village are well-maintained, but feel solemn, even sorrowful, under the clouded sky.
A lonely statue gazes into the distance.
Wounded travelers may not be welcome here.
Hunters have long been unwelcome.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wake up, Yato.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Those... Felynes... said you're poisoned. Do you remember? You need to stay awake.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Stop shaking me... I'm can hear you.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: How do you feel?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: My head feels heavy, and my arm's swollen. Must be the poison.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Their first aid treatment worked. I feel a little better.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That flying creature's claws were venomous. It's my fault for not dodging...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No, it's not.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Those two creatures... they call themselves Felynes. Might be a unique local Feline variant.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We shouldn't have let them go. They seemed to know about the creature. We should have learned everything we could from them first.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What was it they said... they're looking for an antidote? Sorry, I'll go after them. You rest here.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No, we need to go to the village, now.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What? But you're injured, and they told us to wait...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We need to go as soon as possible. There's a huge monster in the forest. We don't know if it'll threaten the village directly, but it was clearly responsible for those marks.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So it must have something to do with the Oripathy, and we have no way to prevent it from moving over a large area. That's what matters right now.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I don't know if the village is already aware of the creature, but our top priority is to communicate the situation to the villagers and organize an evacuation to prevent the infection from spreading.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: But you need rest.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The mission comes first. We need to ensure the villagers' safety.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Fine... I remember the way. I'll carry you there.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yeah?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No need to carry me... I can walk on my own.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Don't mew think there's something odd about this village, Smithy?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I've traveled across the kingdom with the Scriveners.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I've climbed the walls of Castle Schrade, watched the waves at Moga Village, seen countless meowgnificent sights...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: But I'm pawsitive I've never seen a village like this!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Did you see those villagers? They looked like humans, but had ears and tails like ours!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I'm sure there's no record of them in all the libraries of Dundorma.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Not to meowntion, we didn't see a single Hunter!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: There's a Rathalos in the forest, but no Hunters in the village, no gathering hub. How are they supposed to deal with the meownster?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: If this village wasn't founded by the Research Commission, then could this pawssibly not be the New World...? I don't understand. Where are we?

spans.text: If this village wasn't founded by the Research Commission, then could this pawssibly
be the New World...? I don't understand. Where are we?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: So excited!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: W-What? Why?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Wait, Smithy! Do you remember the Rathalos that we ran into? The big guy that suddenly appeared in the forest and came after us?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Then there was a light! Could that have been...? Wait, Smithy?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy? Where are you?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: We're at the village. Are you okay?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I said I... *cough* I'm fine...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: (She's running a high fever...)

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Let's stop and rest here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'll find help.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey! Can anybody help? Someone's hurt!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Anybody? Hello?

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: (Far away) Chikushou! Catch it! That yellow thing!

steps.name: Agitated Villager
steps.text: (Far away) Hurry! It went that way!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Where is everybody?

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: (Far away) There! The thief went that way!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm getting dizzy... Did you evacuate the villagers?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No, this wasn't me.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Thank you... *cough*

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Stop talking. Save your strength.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Isn't it funny? We just started, but somehow this feels like the end...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: D-D-Don't say stuff like that!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato... Yato! Say something!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Crap! Anyone?

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: Excuse me?

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: Do you guys need help?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yes, yes! She's badly hurt.

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: Let me see... was it an animal that did this?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: There's a place that can help her. I'll take you there!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: —! Thank you!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: Over here!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: So shiny!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Want this too!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: So many new tools and meowterials! Yay!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Kuso! Where did that yellow thief get off to?

steps.name: Timid Villager
steps.text: H-He just went that way! Zipped right past my feet!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: After him!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy! Over here!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: What did mew do? Why are so many people after mew?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Look! So much new stuff!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Meow goodness! Don't take people's stuff like that!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: He's here!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Hey, there's another one?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Oh whiskers— let's get to the forest!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: The thief went that way!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The entrance to the forest is blocked! Hey, is that a Hunter's hut?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: A Hunter Hut!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Stop running off like that!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Over here! There's a hole here!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Where did those Felines go?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Shh—

steps.name: Agitated Villager
steps.text: That's... the Kashiwau house. The old man would never let them in.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Ano yarou-domo... Let's look over there! Don't let them get away!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Are they gone? Whew!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrrowagh!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: What is it this time?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrrowagh!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: J-Just some furs hanging off the wall.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: But this place really looks just like a Hunter's House...

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Up there! Can! Mushrooms!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Where? Let me see... on the shelves? Oh, they do indeed appurr to be Blue Mushrooms.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Let's try them. They could make a good antidote!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Shh... pawsteps! Get down!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Let's scampurr!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow! The entrance's boarded up!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: What to do... Is there somewhere we can hide?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: (Swings a hammer) Meow!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I-I suppose that's one way to do it...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The pawsteps are getting closer! We have to do this...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Listen, Smithy, when they come in, jump onto the nearest purr-son's head.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Then do THIS with the hammer!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I'll run past them while they're distracted, and you follow. Understand?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: So excited!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: On meow mark!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Three!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Two!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: One!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow!

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: Almost there... that's the one. It's old Kashiwau's house.

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: He's the village hunter. A good man.

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: He has a lot of things in his house for treating injuries caused by beasts. He can help you.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Thank you so much...

steps.name: Child in Hunter Garb
steps.text: No need to thank me. By the way, my name's Kazuya.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Old Kashiwau often goes into the mountains to hunt and comes back with lots of stuff. He's amazing.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: He also spent a lot of time building a fence around the village so the animals can't get in. He really cares for everyone.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Sounds like quite the guy!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hang in there, Yato. We're almost there.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Oh, he seems to be out. Just pull that stick down to open the door.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: But the owner's out...

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Don't worry, he likes to help people. He'd let you rest if he was here, I guarantee it.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Alright then.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wait here, Yato. I'll get the door.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Is it this one? There... ouch!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ow! My head!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy! Stop!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: It's... the horned Hunter?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The F-Felines?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: With a Y! And don't you dare furget it!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Shake a couple of times... there we go.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Here, have the lass drink this.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: An antidote, of course... I think. There weren't any Blue Mushrooms, so I used something I found here that looked similar. I'm sure it'll work. Just drink it.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: I remember!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: You remember what?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: The newest antidote recipe... doesn't use Blue Mushrooms.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: What? Why didn't you say— Mrow! Well, my recipe uses mushrooms. You shut up!

spans.text: What? Why didn't you say— Mrow! Well,
recipe uses mushrooms. You shut up!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Will Yato get better?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: A horned weirdo who doesn't even gnaw what an antidote herb is...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mew wouldn't ask questions like that if mew had a brain under that horn.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I've just never heard of anything called an antidote herb growing in Terra... Oh, Yato's fever is dropping. Thank goodness.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: So you're saying... this place is called Terra? It's not the New World?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: And you're not a Hunter like the ones we're furmiliar with...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Oh yeah, and stop calling me horned weirdo! I'm here on a mission.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Could this pawssibly be... not the New World, but an entirely diffurent world?

spans.text: Could this pawssibly be... not the New World, but an entirely

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: No... my plans to research the New World!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I would have become the greatest scholar there, respurr-cted by everyone... I'm done fur!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Done fur!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Er... maybe we should introduce ourselves.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'm Noir Corne. And she's...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Yato. Mew've said it so many times now, I can't even get the name out of my fur.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So you aren't Felines, but... Felynes? And you used to live with creatures that look very much like us, before you came here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: In a world where Hunters and monsters exist.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Completely diffurent from here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So did that flying, firebreathing creature come from your world?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The Rathalos? I couldn't say if anything similar lives here, but I am pawsitive this one came with us.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: In our world, they live with Rathians near volcanos and forests. They're really scary wyverns!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So you were yelling at us that the creature was coming. What was the name again? Rath-something...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Are your ears just fur show?!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: It's a Rathalos.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Rathalos... the name does sound impressive.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It could fly so high, breathe huge fireballs, not to mention the venomous claws and a hide so tough it could stop swords... I guess it deserves a scary name.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Purr-cisely, but we have ways of handling them.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: However, you're too weak, and your weapons are useless. Mew shouldn't even think about fighting a Rathalos.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: If it were the legendary Hunter from Bherna Village, he would go 'Eh!' and 'Hmph!'

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: And the Rathalos would be dead.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Just like that?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Just like that?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: You must have Hunters capable of hunting a Rathalos in your village too, Smithy. Purr-haps you just didn't see them.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Anyway, let's set the Rathalos aside and think about how to send meow and Smithy home!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'm here. Are you feeling better?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I've been awake for a while. I was listening to your conversation... Have the villagers been evacuated?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I... I haven't told them yet.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Here's what I'm thinking. We only fought the Rathalos once. We don't know what connection it has to the Originium.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...The chaos caused by a panic or a large-scale evacuation could make it even harder to track the true source of the Originium particles.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Not a bad point. But taking countermeasures is always the priority whenever there is risk of Oripathy infection. Never forget that.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Do you still have a fever? I have a towel here.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Oh, you're awake! Hm?

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Oh, so you two are...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I-It's not like that! Shut up!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Speak, or I'll have to clean bloodstains off my floor today.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wait! Hold on!

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: They got hurt in the mountains. I brought them here.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Hurt?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I took a scratch from a venomous claw. We used some of the ingredients here to make an antidote.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Thank you, and we apologize for bothering you. We'll be leaving now.

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Ano kemono-domo...

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Lie down if you're injured.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Aged Hunter
steps.text: Yoshitaka Kashiwau.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: That's my name. You can call me whatever you please.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm a hunter. There are many beasts in the forests here. Amateurs should avoid them.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Thank you for your assistance. We're—

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I don't need to know who you are.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: And you, over here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: The girl's hurt. Boil some water for her.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: And put that rag down.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...Sure, right away!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Kazuya, grind this up. Dissolve it in water and apply it to the wound.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Felyne Scholar, are you trying to return to your world?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Pawbviously.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I don't know how you and the Rathalos got here, but do you know how to get back?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Good question. I was looking around with Smithy, but there were nothing but trees. We can't go back the way we came, but there might be some other way in the forest.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We can try the forest, but the odds aren't good.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So how about making an agreement with us?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I know a place that may be able to help you return to where you came from.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Where is that?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Rhodes Island, the company Noir Corne and I work for. We often deal with... anomalous events.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Even if there's no immediate way home, it can still provide a safe refuge. Corne and I are in a similar situation ourselves.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: In return, we'll need your knowledge in case we encounter the Rathalos again.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We... may even need to kill it, as you mentioned.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Rathalos hunt!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow... I can't make any purr-omises right now. I need some time.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You have villages where you came from, don't you? Would you just turn a blind eye when there's a threat nearby?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We fought the Rathalos, a creature that has never been seen in these lands before. We know it's not something we can just leave alone.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: More importantly... it may also be linked to another crisis, one that's more familiar to Terra.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Maybe you don't understand what I'm talking about, but we have evidence that we can't afford to waste any time in dealing with the situation.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Oripathy aside... a creature of that size that breathes fire and has venomous claws is a threat simply by virtue of existing so close to a village.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Flying... firebreathing... venomous claws? You saw the beast?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You've seen the Rathalos before too?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We encountered it in the forest, and believe it to be a non-native creature that is highly dangerous. We will continue to investigate and take appropriate measures as needed.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: It's my quarry.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Perfect. As an experienced local hunter who knows these forests, we could really use your skills.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We share a common goal. We should work together. We'll ensure your safety.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Did you not hear me? I said it's my quarry.

spans.text: Did you not hear me? I said it's

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm afraid I don't quite understand. Are you concerned about our combat abilities?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Rhodes Island operators are well-trained and experienced in responding to emergencies. Dealing with anomalous creatures is part of our job.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We were caught by surprise this time, but next time we'll be fully prepared.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Aho! It's my quarry, and I will hunt it... alone.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: How dare you disrespect my claim!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: This Rathalos is an unknown creature that we can't underestimate. It doesn't belong to you.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Ha! Look at the state you got yourself into. And you speak of combat ability?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Weak, worthless worms... Lower than an Originium Slug...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: What are you thinking? No, don't dare even—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No offense, but you have no right to stop us from investigating the Rathalos. It's our job.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm warning you, don't let me see your face in the forest! I don't care who you are!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Just stay away from my quarry!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If you interfere with our mission, we will be forced to consider you a threat and respond accordingly.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I can only hope it doesn't come to that.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Damare!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: ...Get out!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Out of my house! Now!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Out!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I got the water! Huh? What happened?

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Mr. Kashiwau, why...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Let's go, Corne.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wait! Hold on!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: D-Don't throw that! You take care too... E-Excuse us!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow!

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: I'm sorry, I don't know what came over him all of a sudden.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: He's really a very nice person. That wasn't like him at all.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Thank you for your help, Kazuya.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But we're fine. Go keep the old man company.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I don't understand why he was so upset. Just because we're also looking for the Rathalos?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: He lives by himself with no family, far away from the rest of the village, and everything in there looked old and ragged.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Do you remember the hunter statue in the village? I thought it'd be a respected profession here.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Don't worry about it. It won't affect our mission.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We should learn more about this village and look for clues about the Originium contamination.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: I'm sorry... I just wanted to help them.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Are they gone?

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Uh-huh...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: The girl seemed to be getting better.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: *sigh*...
